title: G-quadruplex–stalled eukaryotic replisome structure reveals helical inchworm DNA translocation | Science
content: DNA G-quadruplexes (G4s) are non–B-form DNA secondary structures that threaten genome stability by impeding DNA replication. To elucidate how G4s induce replication fork arrest, we characterized fork collisions with preformed G4s in the parental DNA ...
